verdict.rationale: Warp documents a public REST/JSON API with API-key auth, cursor pagination, rate-limit semantics, an endpoint reference covering company, worker, bank-account, offer and benefit data, and official TypeScript and Go SDKs. An llms.txt index, confirmed by an HTTP 200 probe, makes the docs readable by AI tools, and a CLI is also documented. missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of the API, an OpenAPI spec at a discoverable standard path (all probed paths returned 404), and full API access on base plans, since the advanced API module is gated to Enterprise.
